main_text.p: קָצָה, constr. קְצֵה finis, בִּקְצֵהוּ in extremitate ejus, & מִקְּצֵיהֶם ab extremitatibus suis, No. f. & pl. m. præf. & aff. Rad. קָצָה abscidit.
קְצוֹת extremitates, pl. m constr. No. קְצוֹת, No. f. m. קָצָה finis.
קְצוּצֵי amputati, Paul Kal, pl.m. constr. Kad. קָצַץ.
קָצוֹת extremitates, No. pl. f. Rad. קָצָה.
לִקְצוֹת exscindendo, Infin. Kal, Rad. קָצָה.
לִקְצוֹת exscindere, Infin. Piel, Rad. קָצָה.
קָצִין dux, קְצִינֵי principes, קְצִינֶיךָ tui, No. f. m. & pl. m. aff. Rad. inusit. קצן.
וַיִּקְצָתָה & amputabis, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. parag. Rad. קָצַץ.
קָצָתִי tædio afficior, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. קוץ.
קָר frigidum, קֹר frigus, No. f. m. Rad. קָרַר frigescere.
קִיר paries, f. m. pro No. Rad. קִיר.
קְרָא, vel, קְרוּא vocatus, קְרָאִים, vel, קְרוּאִים vocati, Paul Kal, f. & pl. m. Rad. קָרָא.
קָרָא vocatum fuit, præt. Pual, 3.f.m. Rad. קָרָא.
בִּקְרֹא in vocando me, Inf. Kal, קְרָא, præf. aff. R. קָרָא.
קְרֹא vocare, קְרָאנוּ invocare nos, Infin. Kal, aff. Kad. קָרָא.
קֹרָא perdix, No. f. m. Rad. קָרָא vocavit.
קְרָאָהוּ obvenerit ipsi, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. קָרָא, vel, קָרָה.
קְרָאֵי invocantes, קְרָאָם eum, Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff.

page.notes: Scan has a grey shadow over the left-column entries from "extremitates" to "exscindere"; the Hebrew vowel points there are uncertain. Hebrew words with points were copied as best seen and carry no [?] where the letters were clear; the pointing of קְצוּצֵי, קְצִינֶיךָ, קְרָאָהוּ and קְרָאָם is doubtful. The Hebrew in the right-hand entries is set with small points and may contain errors. The header "ק ר" at the top of the right column was taken as part of the running head. The "Digitized by Google" banner was left out.
